description: DIANA offers a finite-element environment for structural analysis across project lifecycle stages. The provider presents software for engineering assessment and simulation, not a fixed building dataset. Spatial meshes, time steps and constitutive assumptions depend on each project. The software can support infrastructure design and assessment, but the homepage does not validate any particular structural model. Published by DIANA FEA. Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Access is through the provider documentation and software links; no software was installed. Reuse licence: Commercial DIANA licence. Software access is paid under the provider’s terms. Potential simulation uses include capacity planning, optimisation. Related catalogue records: model-opensees. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
